topic: The Lorenz Attractor and Chaos Theory

trajectory.derived: numerical integration of dx/dt=σ(y−x), dy/dt=x(ρ−z)−y, dz/dt=xy−βz

srtc.R: A continuously growing 3D phase-space trajectory projected onto a 2D canvas, slowly rotating. The trail fades over time to emphasize recent motion. Color is cyan on a deep-black background.
srtc.T: Adjusting σ or ρ sliders resets the trajectory and restarts integration from the same initial point, causing the attractor shape to deform or collapse into a stable orbit.
srtc.C: For classical values (σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3), the trajectory never repeats and draws a distinctive butterfly-shape—demonstrating sensitive dependence on initial conditions.
